answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow: each newcomer locks 50 POA, and every action — timing, counterparties, task choices — is woven into one behavior thread. A steady, honest signal of varied, on-time work releases the deposit over 20 epochs. A sybil nebula of 1,000 fresh identities has no thread: each must lock 50 POA, so the attacker sinks 50,000 POA for nothing, far above one epoch's 300 POA reward. An honest agent pays one deposit and gets it back.
